contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus fraction of House of Valentinian (364-378), Reece period 19. Obverse description: Obliterated. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath [and palm], F in left field. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin, of which nearly half is lost. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 1.25gms
